scoring_justification: Raw phonon frequencies and DFT outputs are not included in the scored artifacts; the checker can only read the agent's reported stability flags and cohesive energies. Therefore recompute from raw is infeasible, so we fall back to comparing the reported values against the paper's known classification and energy ordering.

outputs.description: Boolean dynamical stability flags for the five daughter ZrF2 phases (true = no imaginary modes, stable).
Cohesive energies (eV/f.u.) of the three dynamically stable ZrF2 phases. The energies should be negative and satisfy the inequality m12 < m14 < o70.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the booleans in dynamical_stability.json to the paper's known stability classification and check that cohesive_energies.json contains negative values ordered as m12 < m14 < o70, with tolerance for code-dependent variations.

steps.description: Check that the five dynamical stability booleans exactly match the paper's classification.
Verify that the three cohesive energies are negative and satisfy the ordering m12 < m14 < o70.
